The current assertions are fragile because they rely on exact string matching of YAML properties (e.g., specific quoting styles like single vs double quotes, or spacing). Introduce a helper method `assert_yaml_property` that uses regex to robustly match properties regardless of quoting styles.

```python
class CISecurityGuardWorkflowIntegrityTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_yaml_property(self, content: str, key: str, value: str):
        pattern = rf"{re.escape(key)}:\s*['\"]?{re.escape(value)}['\"]?"
        self.assertTrue(
            re.search(pattern, content),
            f"Expected property '{key}: {value}' not found in content:\n{content}"
        )

    def test_pull_request_guard_uses_base_guard_against_candidate_workflows(self):
        workflow = read_workflow()
        pr_job = extract_job(workflow, "pull-request-workflow-trust-boundary")

        self.assertTrue(
            re.search(r"if:\s*github\.event_name\s*==\s*['\"]pull_request['\"]", pr_job),
            "Could not find pull_request event check in job condition",
        )

        trusted_checkout = extract_step(pr_job, "Checkout trusted guard from base")
        self.assert_yaml_property(trusted_checkout, "uses", "actions/checkout@v4")
        self.assert_yaml_property(
            trusted_checkout,
            "repository",
            "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name }}",
        )
        self.assert_yaml_property(
            trusted_checkout,
            "ref",
            "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}",
        )
        self.assert_yaml_property(trusted_checkout, "path", "trusted-guard")
        self.assert_yaml_property(trusted_checkout, "persist-credentials", "false")

        candidate_checkout = extract_step(pr_job, "Checkout candidate repository")
        self.assert_yaml_property(candidate_checkout, "uses", "actions/checkout@v4")
        self.assert_yaml_property(
            candidate_checkout,
            "repository",
            "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}",
        )
        self.assert_yaml_property(
            candidate_checkout,
            "ref",
            "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}",
        )
        self.assert_yaml_property(candidate_checkout, "path", "candidate-repo")
        self.assert_yaml_property(candidate_checkout, "persist-credentials", "false")
```
